results.how_it_works_title: How I Keep Vegan Meals Affordable
results.how_it_works_text: Eating plant-based shouldn't mean buying specialty ingredients every week. Everything here is built around five simple principles that keep the grocery bill low and the meals genuinely satisfying.

how_it_works_list.title: Staple-first cooking
how_it_works_list.text: Rice, beans, lentils, and pasta form the backbone of every meal.

how_it_works_list.title: No overpriced substitutes
how_it_works_list.text: Real whole foods, not $8 vegan cheese or fake meat.

how_it_works_list.title: Planned leftovers
how_it_works_list.text: Every recipe is designed with the next day's lunch in mind.

how_it_works_list.title: Simple seasoning strategy
how_it_works_list.text: Build a small spice kit once, use it in everything.

how_it_works_list.title: Minimal food waste
how_it_works_list.text: Recipes cross-reference ingredients so nothing goes to waste.

results.about_content:
I'm a developer who got tired of overpriced "healthy" recipes and complicated food blogs that assume you have a Whole Foods around the corner.

Hangry Herbivore is where I share simple, budget-focused vegan meals that actually work in real life — no specialty ingredients, no hour-long prep, no guilt about the grocery bill.
results.email_signup_content: Get 7 days of vegan meals under $40 — complete with grocery list and per-serving cost breakdown.
